tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC) in µg/ml for four peptides against several Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. All MICs were performed in Mueller–Hinton bouillon at least three times, and data are stated as the modal value. MRSA stands for methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and VRE for vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecalis.
